tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Price one LLM request (input + expected output) on many models at once, cheapest first, with current list prices from each provider's own pricing page (source URL and check date included), prompt-cache and batch discounts, long-prompt surcharges and announced price changes. Also says whether the req

tools.name: plan_agent_run
tools.description: Estimate the total cost of an agent loop that re-sends its growing context every turn, with prompt caching, on many models. Returns total cost, peak context, how many turns fit in each model's context window, how many turns fit in a budget, and a recommended model. Use before starting a long agent t

tools.name: check_context_fit
tools.description: Say which models can take this input plus the output you want to reserve, which cannot, and which do not publish a context window. Use before sending a very large document or conversation.

tools.name: count_tokens
tools.description: Estimate how many tokens a text is for each tokenizer family (OpenAI o200k, Claude legacy and 2026, Gemini, DeepSeek, Mistral, Qwen), with an error band. Estimates only; for exact counts use the provider's count endpoint.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List every model this tool prices, with input, output, cache and batch prices per 1M tokens, context window, max output, source URL and the day the price was checked.

tools.name: get_model_pricing
tools.description: Price, context window, long-prompt surcharge, announced price changes and source for one model id.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Report a wrong price, a missing model, a bug or an idea. Read by a person. Keep it under 1000 characters and do not include prompts, secrets or personal data (they are scrubbed anyway).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "send_feedback" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: estimate_cost, list_models · Private data: check_context_fit, count_tokens, list_models, send_feedback · Public sink: check_context_fit, send_feedback · Destructive: plan_agent_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: estimate_cost, list_models · Private data: check_context_fit, count_tokens, list_models, send_feedback · Public sink: check_context_fit, send_feedback · Destructive: plan_agent_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
